mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has declined for three consecutive weeks (-16.0 to -17.0). This momentum reflects entrenched reduced footfall habits that persist absent a countervailing shock, so the index continues to drift lower or stay flat-negative over the next four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM dropped from 0.0 to -2.9 across the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 14 days rises relative to the last 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining below -2.0, invalidating the spillover link.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves (less negative) over the next 28 days even though both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain depressed, showing no compounding interaction effect.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -20.9 to -19.1 in the latest week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline (stays flat or rises) in the week immediately following a PARKS uptick, rejecting the substitution mechanism.
